items.headline: Nvidia Blackwell Tech Used at China Site Tied to Alice Huang
items.excerpt: A pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp.’s powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of a controversy surrounding the US chipmaker.

items.headline: OpenAI Says Apple Pressured Suppliers to Shun Its Devices
items.excerpt: The trade-secrets fight between OpenAI and Apple Inc. is widening, with the artificial intelligence company accusing the iPhone maker of undermining its supplier relationships and using unfair employment agreements to prevent talent from jumping ship.

items.headline: Verizon in Talks to Buy Fidium in $6 Billion Deal, FT Says
items.excerpt: Verizon Communications Inc. is in talks to buy the broadband operator Fidium in a $6 billion deal, the Financial Times reported, a move that would expand its network and allow the mobile giant to target more internet service subscribers across the US.

items.headline: Poland Signs $300 Million Palantir Deal to Use AI in Defense
items.excerpt: Poland will use artificial intelligence-based software from Palantir Technologies Inc. to analyze battlefield data, bucking a push by some European allies to reduce their reliance on US technology for critical defense capabilities.

items.headline: How AI Is Changing Black Friday
items.excerpt: Matt Shay, president and CEO of the National Retail Federation, says this may mark a step change in how consumers interact with retailers, as AI begins changing how shoppers shop on Black Friday. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: UK Pension Agency Takes Systems Offline After Cyber Incident
items.excerpt: The UK government’s Department for Work and Pensions took systems offline on Friday as a precautionary measure after officials detected a cyber incident.

items.headline: Black Friday Shoppers Turn to AI Bots to Find Deals
items.excerpt: AI-assisted traffic to US retail sites this holiday season will more than double last year’s, according to Adobe, demonstrating consumers are shifting from search engines to digital assistants. Bloomberg Intelligence's Abigail Gilmartin has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Blackwell Chips Found at Alice Huang-Linked China Site
items.excerpt: A Bloomberg investigation found Chinese firms installed an Nvidia GB300 Blackwell rack at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, despite US restrictions on the hardware. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.excerpt: The software company is trying to fill big gaps in its executive team

items.headline: Hackers Breached US Air Force’s Cloud Platform, Reuters Says
items.excerpt: Hackers breached the US Air Force’s flagship cloud infrastructure, called Cloud One, potentially putting large amounts of sensitive tactical and personnel data at risk, Reuters reported on Friday.

items.headline: AI Data-Center Developer LIAN Picks London for $500 Million IPO
items.excerpt: LIAN Group, a developer of infrastructure for artificial intelligence and computing, has chosen London as the venue for a potential initial public offering next year, in what would be a boost to the city’s lackluster market for new listings.

items.headline: SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Roles in AI Restructure
items.excerpt: SAP SE is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, according to people familiar with the matter, following reductions at Oracle Corp. and Microsoft Corp.

items.headline: Top Africa Fund Manager Buys Grit’s Embassy, Data-Center Assets
items.excerpt: Africa’s largest fund manager is buying Grit Real Estate Income Group Ltd.’s development unit, including its data-center and US embassy portfolio on the continent, with the property firm likely to delist from bourses in London and Mauritius.
